chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from al-Nadr ibn Shu'ayb, from Muhammad ibn al-Fudayl, from Abu Hamza al-Thumali who said: I heard Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) saying: The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) said:

Indeed God, Blessed and Exalted, says: The completion of My argument against the wretched ones from your community is [concerning] those who abandon the wilayah of Ali, ally with his enemies, and deny his merit and the merit of the successors after him.
For your merit is their merit, obedience to you is obedience to them, your right is their right, and disobedience to you is disobedience to them.
And they are the guiding Imams after you. Your spirit flows in them, and your spirit is what has flowed from your Lord into you. They are your progeny from your essence, your flesh, and your blood.

And God, Mighty and Majestic, has caused your Sunnah and the Sunnah of the Prophets before you to flow in them. They are the custodians of My knowledge after you. It is a right upon Me — I have chosen them, selected them, purified them, and am pleased with them.

And salvation is for the one who loves them, allies with them, and submits to their merits. And Jibreel (peace be upon him) came to me with their names and the names of their forefathers, their beloved [followers], and those who submit to their merits.

key_terms.الْأَشْقِيَاء: Al-Ashqiya': the wretched ones; those damned through rejection of the Imams' authority
key_terms.الْأَوْصِيَاء: Al-Awsiya': the successors/legatees; refers to the twelve Imams who succeeded the Prophet
key_terms.خُزَّان: Khuzzan: treasurers/custodians; the Imams are keepers of divine knowledge
key_terms.عِتْرَة: Itra: progeny/kindred; the Prophet's family from his essence
key_terms.وَلَايَة: Wilayah: divine guardianship/authority; in Shia theology, the sacred right of the Imams to lead the community

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about the wilayah of Ali and the authority of the Imams in al-Kafi?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a divine speech (quoting God directly) conveyed through a chain from Imam al-Baqir (AS), who cites the Prophet. God declares that His proof is complete against those who reject the wilayah of Ali and the Imams, equating their authority with the Prophet's own authority. The Imams are described as the Prophet's spiritual and physical progeny, custodians of divine knowledge, and as those whom God has chosen, selected, purified, and is pleased with. The historical context is the early Shia community's struggle to assert the legitimacy of Imamate authority against political opposition; this tradition would have affirmed to early believers that their loyalty to the Imams was itself divinely ordained.
word_analysis: and selected them (chosen from the best)

en.sarwar: 4. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from al-Nadr ibn Shu’ayb from Muhammad ibn al-Fudayl from abu Hamzah al-Thamali who has said that he heard abu Ja’far (a.s.) say, “The Messenger of Allah (s.a.) said: “

Allah, the Most Holy, the Most High, says, “It is to establish my authority over the wicked ones of your people that those who would refuse to acknowledge the Divine authority of Imam Ali (a.s.) and become friend and supporters of the enemies of Ali (a.s.), refuse to acknowledge his virtuous qualities and the such qualities of his successors after him (Imam Ali (a.s).
Indeed your excellence and virtues are their excellence and virtues, obedience to you is like obedience to them, your right is like their right and disobedience to you is disobedience to them.

They will be the Imams who possess the right guidance after you. Your spirit flows in them and so does the spirit of that which your Lord has made to flow in you. They are members of your family of the substance of which you are made. They are your flesh and blood.

Allah, the Most Holy, the Most High, has made your traditions and the traditions of the prophets before to continue with them (the Imams). They (Imams) are the treasurers of My knowledge after you. It is a right that owe them. I have chosen and give to them nobility exclusively with satisfaction.

Salvation will be for those who would love them acknowledge their Divine authority and accept their excellence and virtues. The angel, Jibril has brought for their (Imam’s) names and the names of their fathers, the names of those who would love them and those who would accept their virtues and excellence.”
